item-01: AT ITEM CLOSE, add to the card Known gaps section (docs PR), with these CORRECTED numbers: 10 production rows carry a published issue_size with zero field_sources rows, all created between 2025-12 and 2026-03, none since. Not 39 and not ongoing - an earlier measurement of mine counted 28 seed rows with issue_size=0 as published values and mistook their recent created_at for current behaviour. The cause is data-persister.ts::upsertIPO's fallback door (~lines 1330-1385), which fires when consolidateIPOData throws and sets fieldSourcesWritten:false unconditionally by design. The create door (~line 1406) gates on ENABLE_SOURCE_TRACKING, which defaults false in code but is set true in both shared/env/prod/scraper.env and shared/env/staging/scraper.env, correctly symlinked - so the card's claim that these flags are already on in prod is TRUE and item 1's premise holds. Tracked as #454. Worth noting on the card that the fallback door writes data without provenance SILENTLY - no log, no error - which is the part worth a later check.
